meta.description: Procurement_Implementation_Plan.md §6, bullet 6, now that GET /procurement/reorder-suggestions exists (§3). Scheduled digest to the purchase manager; a button reply calls POST /purchase-requisitions with source=AUTO_REORDER. ProcurementDashboardService.get_reorder_suggestions() is suggest-only (see its docstring / BUSINESS_DECISIONS.md §1) - this workflow is exactly the human-in-the-loop step that turns a suggestion into a real PR, never bypassing PurchaseRequisitionService.submit()/approve().

nodes.name: Purchase manager reply trigger
nodes.notes: Separate trigger within the same workflow, listening for the purchase manager's reply to the digest above (a distinct execution path, not a synchronous continuation of the schedule branch).

nodes.name: POST /purchase-requisitions (source=AUTO_REORDER)
nodes.notes: PurchaseRequisitionService.create_pr() still creates this in DRAFT like any other PR - source=AUTO_REORDER only records provenance, it does NOT skip submit()/approve() (see BUSINESS_DECISIONS.md §1: no auto-approval anywhere).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { department: "Purchase", raised_by: "Reorder Digest Bot (on behalf of Purchase Manager)", required_by_date: $today.plus({days:14}).toISODate(), source: "AUTO_REORDER", items: [ { product_id: $json[0].id, quantity: $json[0].reorder_quantity } ] } }}

parameters.text: =Drafted {{ $json.pr_number }} - still needs submit + approval like any other PR, it wasn't auto-approved.
